posts.subject: Weird issue on SDM
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello guys, especially Sky and Black


So yeah, from today I encounter a weird thing on the SDM server... Let me explain


Each time you ban some one the server get flooded by :


Banned_Guy Left the server (XXX[-X] Points, XXX [-X] Pos)
and
Sourceban : XXX has X SB records etc...


So yeah it's kinda annoying because everyone gets flooded by that... and the only way to fix it ATM is to restart the server so yeah, it's really pissing off the players. So Can you do something or at least make it work [^^] ?


And many players ask me for the R8 Revolver on the SDM server too 😄


Baba
